subject: Creating a report from a Shiny app

messages.author: 791c159e9fcbd222
messages.subject: Creating a report from a Shiny app
parts:
BEFORE I START:  I AM WORKING ON REPRODUCIBLE CODE but am hoping someone knows the simple error I am making in the following:

I have a Shiny app, which works just fine, including making .  I want to generate a report of the results with some interpretation.

So far, I have built a report that I can show on the screen.  It is in html, so uses an html_document in yaml.  The report works perfectly.

But I want to create downloadable pdf version.  This is where the problem arises.  After making the appropriate changes to yaml (pdf_document), I try to make the report.  Everythng works except...

There are several lattice xyplots that are visible in a tab in the app and show up correctly in the html version.  But fail miserably in the pdf version:

The code chunk looks like this:


```{r, fig.align='center', echo = FALSE}

    OID <- params$OID
    OIO <- params$OIO

    lattice::xyplot(d1 ~ Om,
           data= OID,
           grid = TRUE,
           xlab = "Occurence Level Based On Question Set",
           ylab = "Occurrence Index",
           panel=function(x, y) {
             panel.fill("lightyellow")
             panel.grid(h=-1,v=-1,col="grey75")
             panel.xyplot(x, y, type = c("l"))
             panel.abline(h = OccurIndexFunc(OIO[1],0,OIO[2],1), v = OIO[1], lty = 2, col ="green")
             ltext(OIO[1], OccurIndexFunc(OIO[1],0,OIO[2],1), labels= c("Occurrence Index"), offset=-1, cex=0.8)
           }
    )
```
The plot that results looks like this:


This is great, but the pdf version throws this error:

ERROR: pandoc document conversion failed with error 43

And this in the RStudio console:

Hi Joe,
In case you haven't fixed this yet, I suspect this SO answer might be helpful: https://stackoverflow.com/a/26413456/3998203

Basically, you might just need to re-install rmarkdown.
Alan
